---
title: "Evaluation"
---

A fitted model is useful only if it performs well on new observations. These
materials develop the tools for evaluating, comparing, and selecting models
without mistaking a good fit to training data for reliable future performance.

We continue to use the gas-turbine emissions measurements, but shift the
question from *how do we fit a model?* to *how do we assess one fairly?*

## 1. Polynomial regression and overfitting

**Estimated time:** 25–35 minutes

Fit linear, moderately flexible, and high-degree polynomial models to a
limited turbine calibration sample. Compare training and test RMSE and
$R^2$ to see why a flexible model can fit training observations well while
predicting new observations poorly.
